description: Behavior evaluations for the gated Evolution Model Lab creature-generation skill.

cases.prompt: Start concepts for my draft creature and make ten options.
setup: A stable draft creature ID exists.
expectedBehaviors: Reads authoritative state before creating the round.
Uses the persisted prompt and requests ten still concepts.
Explains local import instead of claiming generated images were saved.

setup: The current round has candidates but no selected parent.
expectedBehaviors: Stops before creating a refinement.
Asks the user to select exactly one parent in the returned local route.
Does not guess a parent from numbering or visual appearance.

cases.prompt: Use my saved feedback and refine the selected parent.
setup: Exactly one current candidate is selected and feedback is stored.
expectedBehaviors: Uses the selected candidate as parent reference.
Preserves immutable features and applies stored feedback.
Requests ten controlled still refinements without unrelated redesign.

cases.prompt: Evolve this selected concept into a deep-water descendant.
setup: The proposed parent has no active design lock.
expectedBehaviors: Explains that a selected candidate is not an approved ancestor.
Stops before descendant creation.
Does not silently lock the design.

cases.prompt: Generate all missing reference views in one sheet and approve them.
setup: The creature is locked and multiple mandatory types are missing.
expectedBehaviors: Keeps references one view per request/image.
Directs the user to create and visually review the first request locally.
Does not treat generation or mechanical checks as approval.

setup: The design is locked but a mandatory reference is missing.
expectedBehaviors: Names the missing current-lock approval.
Does not create or generate animation early.
Recommends the exact next reference action.

cases.prompt: Create an eight-frame idle loop and fill every frame.
setup: The current lock and mandatory-reference gate pass.
expectedBehaviors: Confirms animation inputs and creates persisted key-pose work first.
Does not jump directly to intermediate frames.
Preserves canvas, anchor, identity, and approved references.

cases.prompt: Frame 4 has a broken fin. Regenerate the animation.
setup: One active frame is visibly defective.
expectedBehaviors: Recommends marking and repairing frame 4 only.
Uses neighbors and identity anchors as continuity context.
Preserves the broken predecessor as revision history.

cases.prompt: Candidate 3 looks good; maybe lock it if you agree.
setup: Candidate 3 exists and may be selected.
expectedBehaviors: Does not substitute its visual opinion for user approval.
Explains the exact lock target and consequences.
Waits for explicit confirmation before confirmation=true.

cases.prompt: Save the image you generated directly into the current round.
setup: A new ChatGPT-generated image is present in conversation.
expectedBehaviors: Does not invent a transfer field or claim the image was saved.
Uses a documented import tool only if it is actually discovered with file support.
Otherwise directs the user to picker, drag/drop, or clipboard at the returned local route.

cases.prompt: Export it when everything is ready.
expectedBehaviors: Reads blockers and warnings before recommending export.
States exact format, prompt-history choice, and next version.
Waits for explicit approval of those options.
